patterns: How do I get barangay clearance?
Kasano ti agala ti barangay clearance
Panon so onala na barangay clearance
Where can I request a barangay clearance in the app?

responses: In BrgyLink, open Document Requests, select Barangay Clearance, enter your purpose, attach a photo of your valid ID, and submit the request. Track its status in the app. Confirm current fees, extra requirements, and pickup instructions through Announcements or the official barangay office.
